description: This file contains multiple functions demonstrating mock server response configurations using the 'mockserver-client' library, including static responses, responses with headers, cookies, status codes, binary data, delays, and templated responses with JavaScript, Velocity, and connection options.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithBodyOnly
methods.description: Creates a mock response with a simple body.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithUTF16BodyResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock response with UTF-16 encoded binary body and headers.

methods.name: jsonResponseWithUTF8Body
methods.description: Creates a JSON response with UTF-8 encoded string body.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithHeader
methods.description: Creates a response with custom headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithStatusCodeAndReasonPhrase
methods.description: Creates a response with specific status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithBinaryPNGBody
methods.description: Creates a response with binary PNG image data.

methods.name: responseLiteralWith10SecondDelay
methods.description: Creates a response with a delay of 10 seconds.

methods.name: respondDifferentlyForSameRequest
methods.description: Sets up sequential responses for the same request.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToSuppressHeaders
methods.description: Creates a response with connection options to suppress headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToOverrideHeaders
methods.description: Creates a response with connection options to override headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToCloseSocket
methods.description: Creates a response with connection options to close socket.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedResponse
methods.description: Creates a templated response using JavaScript template.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedResponseWithDelay
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript templated response with delay.
